what: Three plates stacked in one slot (photo + name and description) are pinned at screen center over 5000px of scroll. The second and third plates open a face clipped from the bottom edge upward (clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) → 0), covering the plate before. Openings run 1000~2000 and 3000~4000px, and each plate’s photo slowly zooms 1 → 1.1 starting from when it begins to open (0~2000, 1000~4000, 3000~5000). scrub 1 · GSAP default curve (power1.out). Below 768px or with reduced motion, plates are laid out vertically.

options.step: Scroll taken by one panel (px), default 2000
options.open: Scroll distance (px) over which the panel opens, default 1000 — fixed length is (panel count − 1)·step + open

from.where: index.html Plan Menu (original Top .js-plan — pin center center → center+=5000px · scrub 1 · .js-plan02·03 clipPath inset(100% 0 0 0) → 0 · .img scale 1.1)
